chunks: And it is narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn Muḥammad al-Ḥajjāl, from Thaʿlabah ibn Maymūn, from Muḥammad ibn Qays, who said:
I asked Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a man who gives preference to some of his children over others. He said: “Yes, and his wives as well.”
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a man to favor some of his children or wives over others?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the permissibility of preferring some children over others, and extends the same point to wives. In the chapter context on bequests for an heir, it indicates a legal discussion concerning differential preference within one's family.
